The *Kātiyānattheragāthā* is a poetic text preserved within the *Theragāthā* (Thag 6.7), assigned to the six-verse collection of the early Buddhist verses of the elders [SuttaCentral]. On SuttaCentral, it is indexed with nine modern translations across eight languages, including an English translation by Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral].

In terms of textual reuse and parallels, computational analysis by DharmaNexus documents four matching passages shared with the Pali commentary, the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (*Dutiyo bhāgo*), spanning segments §0.4–6.7 [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language comparisons, DharmaNexus aligns verses of the text with six passages in the Chinese *Saṃyuktāgama* (*Zá āhán jīng*, Taishō 99, scroll 50), notably matching segment §1.2 with T 99 at page 367c25 [DharmaNexus].
